title: Pocketwire Advance Pricing Rules — Flat Advance Fee, Plan Discount and Express Fee
content:
Every Pocketwire Advance books one flat advance fee on its disbursement date. The flat advance fee is the advance amount multiplied by the tier's flat fee rate, rounded to the cent (half up), then raised to the tier's minimum flat fee where it is below it and lowered to the tier's maximum flat fee where it is above it.

While the linked Pocketwire Personal Account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit, the flat advance fee as it stands after that raising and lowering is reduced by the tier's plan fee discount percentage of it, and the reduced fee is rounded to the cent (half up). The discount never applies to express, late or extension fees.

An express delivery books an express fee taken from the tier's express fee bands: the fee of the first band whose upper bound is at or above the advance amount.

There is no interest, and no fee other than those named in the Pocketwire Advance terms is ever charged.

## Order of the flat fee calculation

1. The rated fee is the advance amount multiplied by the flat fee rate, rounded to the cent (half up).
2. The clamped fee is the rated fee raised to the minimum flat fee or lowered to the maximum flat fee where it falls outside them.
3. On Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit, the flat advance fee is the clamped fee less the plan fee discount percentage of it, rounded to the cent (half up); on any other plan it is the clamped fee.

## Worked figures (hypothetical advances, tier figures from the fee schedule)

| Tier | Advance | Linked plan | Rate applied | Raised or lowered | Plan discount | Flat advance fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 200.00 | Pocketwire Core | 5.00 percent gives 10.00 | Within 1.00 to 10.00 | None | 10.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 200.00 | Pocketwire Onyx | 5.00 percent gives 10.00 | Within 1.00 to 10.00 | 10 percent of 10.00 is 1.00 | 9.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 20.00 | Pocketwire Core | 5.00 percent gives 1.00 | Within 1.00 to 2.50 | None | 1.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 50.00 | Pocketwire Summit | 5.00 percent gives 2.50 | Within 1.00 to 2.50 | 0 percent | 2.50 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 35.00 | Pocketwire Onyx | 4.50 percent gives 1.575, rounded 1.58 | Within 1.00 to 13.50 | 10 percent of 1.58 is 0.158 | 1.42 (1.422 rounded) |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 135.00 | Pocketwire Summit | 4.00 percent gives 5.40 | Within 1.00 to 16.00 | 20 percent of 5.40 is 1.08 | 4.32 |

On Pocketwire Advance Basic, whose maximum flat fee is 5.00, a hypothetical advance of 100.00 gives 5.00 at the rate and stays at 5.00; if it is sent by express delivery it also books the express fee of the band up to 100.00, 2.99, which no plan discount reduces.
